title: Research: rectangular output borrowing and complete minimum-word census (no new kappa)
body:
Dense batches `y_i += A_i sum_j B_j x_j` need repeated restoration when completed separately by source or output. This **recursive-interface research construction** batches both axes using the outputs as temporary connectors. For three sources and four outputs, the literal balanced lowering uses **182 primitive calls versus 302 and 306**, with the same **two extra dirty rows**. The dedicated-connector alternative still wins work at **122 calls and three rows**. No new kappa or measured runtime improvement is claimed.

The written proof establishes **4m+2k complete queries** as sharp in the explicit output-only, unit-generator alphabet, including feedback and arbitrary noncommuting operators. It also gives the optimum for positive, sign-symmetric, port-independent query prices. The leaf counts are attained schedules, not unrestricted leaf optima. The complete recurrence charges every recursive child and inverse, source/coefficient access, scratch, frame-adapter obligations, scalar cleanup, preparation/control storage and head return.

A new exact classification finds **76,032 minimum twelve-query words** for two sources and two outputs. One implementation uses projection/shuffle counting with a coverage check recovering all **12! = 479,001,600** candidates. A second implementation explicitly materializes, deduplicates and executes every one of the 76,032 successful full words over independent formal inputs. The predecessor's 224 one-source words are corroborated and credited.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.10+ and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/rectangular-output-borrowing/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/rectangular-output-borrowing/test_package.py
```

Expected markers: `PASS_RECTANGULAR_OUTPUT_BORROWING` and `PASS_RECTANGULAR_PACKAGE`.

Validation passes: 1,296 complete child boundaries and 10,548 primitive occurrences in the fixed 16-point grid, additional seed fixture, 612 independent dense forward/inverse cases, scalar-prefix and independently derived data-tape invoices, 14 mathematical/admission controls, three full-census controls, a port-price counterexample, ten actual package corruptions, normal/optimized offline relocation, selected-record integrity, all **25 selected-result tests**, and whitespace/scope checks. The certificate, complete literal words, source pins, scope and exact command receipts are in the package. No cold supplier replay, repository-wide regeneration, hosted-CI success or Lean multiplication proof is claimed.

Exact experimental base: `abdc6a7002abdbcd9e21bfc5e1a795784deacfdf`; OS-random assignment seed **54**, recursive-interfaces track. Only `research/rectangular-output-borrowing/` is added. Upstream and the selected frontier are untouched. Main advanced during the run to `ba82555c64e1879e4b7decce28186f208fcb8262` with reviewed PR1042; there is no package-path overlap or dependency on that newer construction. Supplier placement, physical/common-label realization, hosting, precision/tape compilation and outer analytic transfer remain open.

Direct predecessors: **Ross Richardson / PR982** at `5eca5b435d2ce172edf6ffb85694c7efa31bf114` and **CubeJerry / PR889** at `e2021d1c9e06948528cbc0a8fd7079b671da981d`. Original proof/README and notices are retained with Git-blob and SHA256 pins. PR628/673/822 and the broader lineage retain credit. The last overlap refresh reached PR1101; PR997/1088 retain a dedicated connector, PR990 has a native BIT contract, PR1057 changes descendant scratch, and PR1083 formalizes another grammar. No pinned coordination issue exists, so the claim and final handoff are local.

Prepared for **@steph4n-gh with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, under Apache-2.0. Separate agent implementations are disclosed as AI-assisted checks, not external human peer review. No algebraic priority claim or request to merge is made.
